_note: Pace is words a minute while reading AND making notes. Exam benchmark: the six Jan and June 2026 question papers average 3,804 words (measured from knowledge_docs/mark_plan), plus 20% = about 4,565 words, read in 35 to 40 minutes, which is 114 to 130 words a minute.
_live: Exercises that also open as a public live-session link, /live/<id>: no sign-in; the visitor gives an email and the attempt is saved for the coach (Tools > Live-session attempts). Marking is limited per browser per day and in total per day.
